name: hue-and-seek
description: Hue & Seek - an original 3D online multiplayer camouflage hide & seek game

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared --noEmit && tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p client --noEmit
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w client && node e2e/multiplayer.e2e.mjs && tsx e2e/props.e2e.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:integration && npm run test:modes && npm run test:props && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:voice
